text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for today, Trainer. ...The 
'Mile CS' is coming up soon, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... Alright. Well then, Trainer. 
Tomorrow's menu is—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh? Even though the real race is coming 
up so soon...?
choice_data_list:
It's precisely because race day is coming 
up that we should take a break for now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Things have gone smoothly so far, making 
it hard to believe she collapsed once 
before, but we shouldn't be overly 
optimistic."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We cannot afford to make the same mistake 
twice. I tell K.S. Miracle that truly 
taking time to rest is just as important.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, resting the body is important. 
But considering K.S.Miracle's mentality, 
and how prone they are to pushing 
themselves to the brink—
choice_data_list:
I hope you get to play and have a ton of 
fun!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Play to my heart's content...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To my heart's content... Hmm, all out, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(To be honest, I can't really think of 
what I should do... but...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Properly. ...Yeah, I need to think about 
this properly. It's what Trainer said to 
me.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yeah. Let's do just that, together."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yeah. Let's do that, together."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(That person told me... someone like me... 
that they'd walk together with me once 
more.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I want to... properly answer those 
feelings.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "...Right. At times like this...!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"TODAY is a HOLIDAY! Time to get 
hyper-super-cray-cray hyped! And the 
god-tier party girl for a time like this 
is..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fooooooo～～～～！！

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you, Helios...! Your big race is 
coming up soon too, so sorry for bothering 
you so suddenly, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Don't even worry about that~!! Like, not 
hanging out would totally kill my vibe 
anyway? You're seriously a god for 
inviting me!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah, Helios was suuuper looking 
forward to today! When we talked on the 
phone yesterday, she just couldn't stop 
talking about it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well, I suppose that's fine 
then... Palmer, thanks for coming, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm the one who's just tagging 
along to have some fun with the two of 
you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Well then, let's get right to 
it!! Operation: Have a Blast with 
Miracle~!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(And ever since then, Helios— has really, 
truly been incredible the whole time.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Before I knew it, after transferring 
trains over and over, I ended up somewhere 
really wonderful, and then—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(It seems it wasn't her planned 
destination at all. She just laughed and 
said, 'It was totally on a whim!')

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(All we caught were seaweed and a baseball 
cap, but Helios couldn't stop laughing. 
Palmer was laughing, and... I was laughing 
too.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Everywhere we went, it was like that. 
Helios was having a blast the whole time, 
and Palmer was too... so, I was as well.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(When was the last time I laughed this 
much? My cheeks are actually starting to 
hurt a little.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Even I was surprised, wondering, "Really? 
This much?")

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...—It was fun.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That right there is what's so amazing 
about Helios, you know?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, more!! Turn it up, are you 
ready~? Say! Hooo!!

text_block_list.name: Club Guests
text_block_list.text: Ohooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
More than anyone or anything, I'm the one 
who's most pumped! And then I drag 
everyone around me into my pace with 
everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'll shine on them! I'll hype them up! 
...It's really incredible, seriously.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...So, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I was kinda hoping that today would be a 
chance for Miracle to get even more swept 
up in Helios's pace!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh... Me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right! ...How should I put it? It's not 
like I didn't enjoy it before, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like... when someone tells you, "Go all 
out, just empty your head!", don't you 
kinda end up hitting the brakes instead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I know what you mean. I was the 
exact same way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you think, "I HAVE to do this!" 
it just puts the brakes on your ability to 
have fun, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And if that gets too strong, you end up 
forgetting how to actually enjoy yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you know. At times like that, 
she always smiles and reminds me of what's 
most important.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Miracle. You're running with Helios next 
time too, right? Then hey, why don't you 
give it a shot once?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Once in a while, empty your head! Just be 
true to the feelings welling up inside."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Together with that sun, you can do it. 
...Right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Palmer...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Be true... to these welling feelings.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(To the way I felt... when I was 
running...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
choice_data_list: Miracle. Are you about ready to go?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I walk through the underground paddock 
tunnel together with Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I can hear the roar of the crowd. Today 
is a GⅠ. My opponents are the greatest 
rivals—each uniquely strong.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I'm heading out, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Getting a push on the back, being sent 
off.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (I sprint forward.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (That is...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (That was, incredibly—...)
